story.summary: Phase 2_04: Improve Paper Out/Export to track if saving digital or papering out
story.description: Currently, the Paper Out/Export has logic for the Media Type that displays in the 1st section of the front/cover page and in the audit trail. If the Paper Out is performed via UI, it displays Paper. If the Export is performed via API, it displays Electronic. This ticket enhances the Media Type logic and the Export process to capture and log whether the user intends to maintain the package digitally outside of the eAsset Management Platform or to convert to paper. For reference, below are the current Paper Out Request and Additional Information modals. NOTE: When updating the Paper Out Request modal, we should clean up and align the section borders on the right side of the modal.

requirements.description: The Paper Out Request modal (transaction or document level) gains a new "Media Type for Paper Out Package" section with two radio buttons: "Print to Paper" (selected by default) and "Save as Electronic File".
requirements.originalText: Add a new Media Type for Paper Out Package section with two radio buttons: Print to Paper - Defaults selected Save as Electronic File

requirements.description: When the user selects "Save as Electronic File" and clicks OK after the modal's required field edits are complete, a new acknowledgement modal opens with an unchecked checkbox that gates its own OK button; its Cancel button is always enabled and closes only the acknowledgement modal.
requirements.originalText: When Save as Electronic File is selected and user clicks OK, open a new acknowledgement modal AFTER the required field edits are complete. Checkbox Blank by default When selected, enables the OK button When deselected, disables the OK button OK button When selected, closes the acknowledgement modal and then the Paper Out Request modal and proceeds with the creating the Work Queue item for the approval. Cancel button Always enabled. Closes the acknowledgement modal

requirements.description: eoRequestExport / export.xsd gains an optional mediaType element with two valid enumerations, PrintToPaper and SaveAsElectronicFile; it is optional so that omitting it never breaks an existing integrator.
requirements.originalText: Add a mediaType element with two valid enumerations: PrintToPaper SaveAsElectronicFile mediaType is optional since requiring it would break existing integrators Update the schema

requirements.description: The system determines a package's Media Type as "Paper" when the UI selects Print to Paper or the API passes mediaType=PrintToPaper, and as "Electronic" when the UI selects Save as Electronic File, the API passes mediaType=SaveAsElectronicFile, or the API passes no mediaType at all. This applies regardless of whether the Paper Out/Export is requested at the transaction level or the document level.
requirements.originalText: The following is applicable regardless of whether the Paper Out/Export is requested at the Transaction level or the Document level. ... Media Type = Paper if: UI user selects Print to Paper OR eoRequesExport passes PrintToPaper in the mediaType Media Type = Electronic if: UI user selects Save as Electronic File OR eoRequestExport passes SaveAsElectronicFile in mediaType OR eoRequestExport does not pass mediaType

requirements.description: Media Type is logged as Additional Information on the "Submitted Paper Out" event instead of "Authorized Paper Out", and is visible on the package cover page and in the audit trail (both in the UI and in downloaded activity history reports), for transaction and/or document level as applicable. Existing transactions and documents are not retroactively updated with this information.
requirements.originalText: Currently, Media Type is logged in Additional Information for the Authorized Paper Out event. This should be moved to the Submitted Paper Out event since that is where the user is specifying how the Paper Out will be managed. As mentioned above, this is applicable for transaction and/or document (depending on where the Paper Out is initiated). We are NOT retroactively updating existing documents and/or transactions.

requirements.description: The Verify Paper Out modal's last checkbox verbiage changes from "Verify the downloaded package has been successfully printed" to "Verify the downloaded package has been successfully printed to paper or saved to a secure location".
requirements.originalText: Update the verbiage of the last checkbox: Current: Verify the downloaded package has been successfully printed Update: Verify the downloaded package has been successfully printed to paper or saved to a secure location

requirements.description: The Paper Out Request modal's right-side section borders are cleaned up and visually aligned as part of adding the new Media Type section.
requirements.originalText: NOTE: When updating the Paper Out Request modal, we should clean up and align the section borders on the right side of the modal. ... Clean up the formatting on the right side of the modal so section borders are aligned.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Paper Out Request modal (transaction or document level) displays a "Media Type for Paper Out Package" section with "Print to Paper" (default selected) and "Save as Electronic File" radio buttons.
acceptanceCriteria.originalText: Add a new Media Type for Paper Out Package section with two radio buttons: Print to Paper - Defaults selected Save as Electronic File

acceptanceCriteria.then: A "Media Type for Paper Out Package" section is shown with two radio buttons, "Print to Paper" (selected by default) and "Save as Electronic File"

acceptanceCriteria.description: Selecting "Save as Electronic File" and clicking OK after required fields are complete opens an acknowledgement modal whose OK button is disabled until its checkbox is checked.
acceptanceCriteria.originalText: When Save as Electronic File is selected and user clicks OK, open a new acknowledgement modal AFTER the required field edits are complete. Checkbox Blank by default When selected, enables the OK button When deselected, disables the OK button
acceptanceCriteria.given: The user has selected "Save as Electronic File" and completed the modal's required field edits
acceptanceCriteria.then: An acknowledgement modal opens with an unchecked checkbox, and its OK button stays disabled until the checkbox is checked

acceptanceCriteria.description: Confirming the acknowledgement modal closes both modals and creates the Work Queue approval item.
acceptanceCriteria.originalText: OK button When selected, closes the acknowledgement modal and then the Paper Out Request modal and proceeds with the creating the Work Queue item for the approval.
acceptanceCriteria.given: The acknowledgement modal is open and its checkbox is checked
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user clicks the acknowledgement modal's OK button
acceptanceCriteria.then: The acknowledgement modal closes, the Paper Out Request modal closes, and a Work Queue item is created for approval

acceptanceCriteria.description: Cancelling the acknowledgement modal closes only that modal, leaving the Paper Out Request modal open and creating no Work Queue item.
acceptanceCriteria.originalText: Cancel button Always enabled. Closes the acknowledgement modal
acceptanceCriteria.then: Only the acknowledgement modal closes; the Paper Out Request modal remains open and no Work Queue item is created

acceptanceCriteria.description: eoRequestExport accepts a request with no mediaType element unchanged, preserving backward compatibility.

acceptanceCriteria.given: An integrator calls eoRequestExport without a mediaType element
acceptanceCriteria.then: The request is accepted exactly as before this change

acceptanceCriteria.description: The updated export.xsd only accepts PrintToPaper or SaveAsElectronicFile as valid mediaType values.
acceptanceCriteria.originalText: Add a mediaType element with two valid enumerations: PrintToPaper SaveAsElectronicFile ... Update the schema
acceptanceCriteria.given: An integrator calls eoRequestExport with a mediaType element
acceptanceCriteria.then: Only PrintToPaper or SaveAsElectronicFile are accepted as valid values

acceptanceCriteria.originalText: Media Type = Paper if: UI user selects Print to Paper
acceptanceCriteria.given: A transaction-level Paper Out is submitted via the UI with "Print to Paper" selected

acceptanceCriteria.originalText: The following is applicable regardless of whether the Paper Out/Export is requested at the Transaction level or the Document level. ... Media Type = Paper if: UI user selects Print to Paper

acceptanceCriteria.description: A document-level Paper Out submitted via the UI with Save as Electronic File is recorded as Media Type Electronic.
acceptanceCriteria.originalText: The following is applicable regardless of whether the Paper Out/Export is requested at the Transaction level or the Document level. ... Media Type = Electronic if: UI user selects Save as Electronic File
acceptanceCriteria.given: A document-level Paper Out is submitted via the UI with "Save as Electronic File" selected

acceptanceCriteria.description: A transaction-level eoRequestExport call with mediaType=PrintToPaper is recorded as Media Type Paper.
acceptanceCriteria.originalText: OR eoRequesExport passes PrintToPaper in the mediaType
acceptanceCriteria.given: eoRequestExport is called at the transaction level with mediaType=PrintToPaper

acceptanceCriteria.description: A document-level eoRequestExport call with mediaType=PrintToPaper is recorded as Media Type Paper.
acceptanceCriteria.originalText: The following is applicable regardless of whether the Paper Out/Export is requested at the Transaction level or the Document level. ... OR eoRequesExport passes PrintToPaper in the mediaType
acceptanceCriteria.given: eoRequestExport is called at the document level with mediaType=PrintToPaper

acceptanceCriteria.description: A transaction-level eoRequestExport call with mediaType=SaveAsElectronicFile is recorded as Media Type Electronic.
acceptanceCriteria.originalText: OR eoRequestExport passes SaveAsElectronicFile in mediaType
acceptanceCriteria.given: eoRequestExport is called at the transaction level with mediaType=SaveAsElectronicFile

acceptanceCriteria.description: A document-level eoRequestExport call with mediaType=SaveAsElectronicFile is recorded as Media Type Electronic.
acceptanceCriteria.originalText: The following is applicable regardless of whether the Paper Out/Export is requested at the Transaction level or the Document level. ... OR eoRequestExport passes SaveAsElectronicFile in mediaType
acceptanceCriteria.given: eoRequestExport is called at the document level with mediaType=SaveAsElectronicFile

acceptanceCriteria.description: An eoRequestExport call (transaction or document level) that omits mediaType entirely is recorded as Media Type Electronic.
acceptanceCriteria.originalText: OR eoRequestExport does not pass mediaType
acceptanceCriteria.given: eoRequestExport is called, at transaction or document level, with no mediaType element passed

acceptanceCriteria.description: Media Type is logged as Additional Information on the Submitted Paper Out event and is visible on the cover page and audit trail, both in the UI and downloaded reports.
acceptanceCriteria.originalText: Currently, Media Type is logged in Additional Information for the Authorized Paper Out event. This should be moved to the Submitted Paper Out event since that is where the user is specifying how the Paper Out will be managed.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A Paper Out is submitted, at transaction or document level, after this change ships
acceptanceCriteria.when: The Submitted Paper Out event is logged
acceptanceCriteria.then: Media Type appears as Additional Information on that event (not on Authorized Paper Out), and is visible on the package cover page and in the audit trail in both the UI and downloaded activity history reports

acceptanceCriteria.originalText: We are NOT retroactively updating existing documents and/or transactions.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A transaction or document had Paper Out/Export performed before this change was deployed
acceptanceCriteria.then: That existing record is not retroactively updated with Media Type information

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Verify Paper Out modal's last checkbox reads the updated verbiage.
acceptanceCriteria.originalText: Update the verbiage of the last checkbox: Current: Verify the downloaded package has been successfully printed Update: Verify the downloaded package has been successfully printed to paper or saved to a secure location
acceptanceCriteria.given: The Verify Paper Out modal is displayed
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user views its last checkbox
acceptanceCriteria.then: The label reads "Verify the downloaded package has been successfully printed to paper or saved to a secure location"

acceptanceCriteria.originalText: Clean up the formatting on the right side of the modal so section borders are aligned.
acceptanceCriteria.given: The redesigned Paper Out Request modal, including the new Media Type section, is rendered
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user views the right side of the modal
acceptanceCriteria.then: The section borders are visually aligned rather than misaligned/overlapping

ambiguities.question: Notes to QA (customfield_11389) lists "Verify Paper Out via Collections works with the updates" as a required test, but neither the description nor the Acceptance Criteria field names Collections as a distinct entry point or flow. Does a Paper Out initiated from Collections use the same Paper Out Request modal covered by AC-EC-12000-001 through AC-EC-12000-004 and AC-EC-12000-007 through AC-EC-12000-010, or a separate flow that needs its own acceptance criteria?
ambiguities.impact: Until this is answered, coverage of the Collections entry point cannot honestly be claimed as included in the existing UI criteria, and no criterion can be written for it without guessing whether it shares the same modal and logic.
ambiguities.resolution: Yes - Paper Out initiated from Collections uses the same Paper Out Request modal as AC-EC-12000-001 through AC-EC-12000-004 and AC-EC-12000-007 through AC-EC-12000-010. Navigation path: Collections accordion > Batch option > Paper Out Request.

ambiguities.question: customfield_11451 ("API Test Required?") is set to "Yes", and this story adds an optional mediaType element to eoRequestExport / export.xsd, but this framework's API-surface inventory (reports/validation/ecore-api-discovery.json) does not document eoRequestExport's current request/response contract. Per framework policy, an API contract may never be authored by an agent from ticket text alone - who will capture and approve the authoritative contract for eoRequestExport before any API-facing criterion can be judged?
ambiguities.impact: AC-EC-12000-005, AC-EC-12000-006 and AC-EC-12000-011 through AC-EC-12000-015 cannot be judged by any test until the eoRequestExport contract is captured as OBSERVED via Playwright MCP network capture and then promoted to HUMAN_APPROVED at Gate 2. The ticket text is not, by itself, an authoritative contract.
ambiguities.resolution: No authoritative eoRequestExport contract exists today. The contract will be marked OBSERVED / API_CONTRACT_UNVERIFIED and captured via Playwright MCP network observation at the PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION stage. It cannot back an approved assertion until a human explicitly reviews the observed contract and promotes it to HUMAN_APPROVED at the applicable test-plan gate.

ambiguities.question: The Acceptance Criteria field states the acknowledgement modal opens "AFTER the required field edits are complete", but neither the description nor the Acceptance Criteria field names which fields on the Paper Out Request modal are required. Is the acknowledgement modal gated on validation of other, unrelated required fields, or does it appear unconditionally once "Save as Electronic File" and OK are selected?
ambiguities.impact: AC-EC-12000-002 currently asserts a precondition ("required field edits are complete") without knowing which fields those are, so a scenario cannot state what must be filled in first without guessing.
ambiguities.resolution: The required field edits that gate the acknowledgement modal are "Name of Request:" and "Approver:" on the Paper Out Request modal. Test data to be used at implementation: Approver = the currently logged-in user's name; Name of Request (requester name) = "Anil Kumar".
